name: batch_run
description: Run EVERY program (.exe) and installer (.msi) packed in one .zip, each in its own isolated runtime, side by side (never on this computer). Use it when the user asks to run a zip that holds several programs: give the zip's file name in this computer's Downloads folder (name only, never a path). The zip is not unpacked on this computer; each runtime gets its own copy, unpacks it there and runs one program (an .msi opens its install window there, as msiexec /i does; inputs are not sent to batch runtimes, so the person finishes an installer in its window). The first program runs in Windows Sandbox when it is free, the others in micro_VMs. You do not call task_submit, inbox_import or sandbox_run for it. It returns at once; then call batch_status with wait_ms=60000 until settled is true (starting takes 1-3 minutes; not settled yet is normal). If the zip holds more programs than this Host runs at once, nothing is started and the limit is reported: tell the user. For one program, or a project zip that must be built, use sandbox_run instead.

name.description: File name of the .zip in the Downloads folder, without any folder part.

entries.description: Only to run some of the zip's files: their paths inside the zip. Leave it out to run every .exe and .msi. A file named here may also be a script that runs by itself (.ps1, .py, .js, .rb, .java, .sh).

annotations.title: Run each program of a zip in its own runtime
